question: Which of the following Articles says that double jeopardy which says that "no person shall be prosecuted or punished for the same offence more than once." ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 20 (2).**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Double jeopardy** means that a person cannot be prosecuted or punished for the same offense more than once.
 
• Double jeopardy is a fundamental principle of law in many countries, including the **United States and India**.
 
• The General Clauses Act of **1897** offers defense against double jeopardy as well.
 
• **Article 20(2) **of the Indian Constitution guarantees protection against double jeopardy.
 
• Article 20(2) also guarantees protection against** self-incrimination **and retroactive punishment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 21(2): **

 
 
• **​**It deals with the right to life and** personal liberty**.
 
• Article 21(2) guarantees the right to a **fair trial **and due process of law.
 
 
 
• **Article 19(1):**
 
 
• It guarantees** freedom of speech**.
 
• It guarantees several other freedoms, including the **right to assemble** peacefully and the** right to practice any profession** or occupation.
 
 
 
• **Article 22(2):**
 
 
• It deals with the rights of **arrested persons.**
 
• Article 22(2) guarantees the **right to be informed **of the grounds of arrest and to consult a legal practitioner.
